harnessMismatch: The original Native scope verifier depended on a removed Quick Switch selector and then on compound attribute selectors unsupported by the Lynx DevTool query implementation. The retained verifier now isolates project-scope behavior and measures its real semantic selectors.

Detached lynx-devtool and agent-browser daemons were external harness residue, not product loss. The verifier now owns a unique DevTool daemon port, uses daemonless console reads, and verifies the exact listener PID exits.
productLoss: The Native scope popup used a fixed 250px width at x=12, escaped the 256px Sidebar rail, and lacked a reliable outside-dismiss path.

Native project cards permanently hid session-derived status and time behind ellipsis and settle controls, displayed a model-name row absent from Web, and used a blue placeholder dot instead of the shared folder fallback.

The repaired cards expose ready or running session state in the authority status slot, keep actions in the long-press menu, restore the compact folder/provider hierarchy and active surface, and render the scope menu through Lynx's built-in overlay element.
classification.ledgerScope: Matched Browser evidence updates Lynx content, geometry, material, and runtime. Exact-bundle Native updates content, geometry, interaction, and runtime; Native material remains representative rather than a Native-to-Web pixel residual.
